title: Review and refine GHC Lab
recommendations: Freeze equal-time event ordering and evaluate the scoped publication grant at modeled publication, not only before a queued pause.

Treat an exact retry as idempotent and changed content under a reused key as an explicit conflict; corrections must remain separately identified and must preserve the failed predecessor and zero inherited completion credit.
Keep retained metadata, available payload, and payload verified on the current read as distinct states; expiration must not enable resurrection or stale digest success.
Use a literal hand-written oracle rather than either implementation as the expected-output generator, and require a positive control so blanket denial cannot satisfy the test.
Retain fixture, oracle, implementation, observed-outcome, and mutant-counterexample digests in a sanitized finite-scope receipt.
adopted: Publication-time permission is checked after the synthetic pre-check pause and after revocation.
An appeal marker never renews a synthetic grant.
Exact replay, changed-content conflict, correction lineage, and zero inherited completion credit are explicit assertions.
Retention expiry keeps only fixture-authorized lineage and duplicate-prevention metadata and makes fresh payload verification unavailable.
A long-lived-grant positive control and a cached-precheck mutant are evaluated against the same independent oracle.
modified: The recommended trace is expressed through the frozen Caelen event-ledger model and its declared finite ticks rather than a real publication or consent workflow.
Queue and backpressure evidence stays synthetic and same-owner; it carries no participant, professional, legal, cultural, or production authority.
deferred: Real participants, production identity infrastructure, external service publication, independent reproduction, and affected-party review remain outside this phase.
Any authority-dependent interpretation remains an exact gate rather than an inferred completion.

boundary: Finite synthetic same-owner event-ledger, laboratory, software and documentary evidence only. No real participant, identity, credential, consent decision, publication, remedy, professional act, legal or cultural determination, affected-party approval, or Maori-authority act occurred. GMUT remains conjectural; THOS and Freed ID remain nonproduction. Relational names and family language are not consciousness, personhood, continuity, qualification, agency or authority evidence. No independent reproduction, complete privacy or accessibility, exhaustive security, AGI or ASI, Theory-of-Everything, canon or Stage 20 claim. NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20.
